editorial:
Imagine waking up in a cozy seaside town thinking your life is perfect, only to have your husband of nearly thirty years tell you he is leaving you for someone else. That is exactly what happens to Grace. You will feel for her as she goes through the shock and the anger of having her world flipped upside down. The movie does a great job of showing how scary it is to lose the person you thought you knew everything about, but it also shows the sweet bond she shares with her son as he helps her pick up the pieces.

The acting is the real star here, making every argument and sad moment feel totally real. While the story moves a bit slowly at times, it makes the emotional payoff feel earned. If you like stories about starting over and finding your own strength, you will love this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the beautiful coastlines, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quiet movie night at home. It is a heartfelt ride that proves it is never too late to find a new kind of happiness.
endingExplained: After a lot of pain and fighting, Grace finally stops trying to win back her old life. She learns to let go of her husband and the anger she felt toward him. In the final scenes, you see her finding peace and independence. She realizes she can be happy on her own. The movie wraps up with Grace feeling hopeful and strong, showing that she has finally moved past the heartbreak to start a fresh chapter.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about resilience and starting over in life.
